rows.en: <operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>Let me explain the <book(76)>Promised Land<endbook()> to you all.
rows.notes: Promised Land = book(76) per encyclopedia_022 text_id 76.

rows.en: <operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>The <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()><thumbnail(284)> that forms this Earth's land has been wounded by repeated wars, and has given rise to <book(73)>Antibody Coralians<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Scub Coral / Antibody Coralian per mission_terms_019/encyclopedia_022.

rows.en: <operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>Those <book(73)>Antibody Coralians<endbook()>, driven by <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()>, become <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()>, and they keep eroding the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Reordered clause (driven by ... become ...) to keep the four book tags in source order 73,51,49,69.

rows.en: <operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>Fearing annihilation from this chain of destruction, the will of the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> fled to the <book(76)>Promised Land<endbook()>.

<operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>The <book(76)>Promised Land<endbook()> lies beyond the <book(75)>Zone<endbook()>, and there it longs for dialogue with <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> and her counterpart... <color(4)>Renton<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'the Zone' lowercase mid-sentence per encyclopedia_022 body convention.

rows.en: <topic()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>By making contact with <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()>, we gained the possibility of dialogue with the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>.

<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>But meanwhile, <color(5)>Dewey<ce()><thumbnail(194)> seized control of the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>. And the ground attacks by <book(81)>Orange<endbook()> stopped.
rows.notes: Dewey per character_names_021 (Dewey Novak, en_short Dewey).

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Dewey<ce()> must have grasped where the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>'s core, the <book(80)>Command Cluster<endbook()>, lies.
rows.notes: Reworded so book(69) precedes book(80), matching source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>The <book(80)>Command Cluster<endbook()> lies beyond<thumbnail(285)> the <book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()> we're headed for.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Dewey<ce()>'s aim is to destroy the <book(80)>Command Cluster<endbook()>. If he does, Earth hits the <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> and collapses.
rows.notes: 'Limit of Questions' = locked rendering of Kudan no Genkai (per 4004663.json / batch_05943 orchestrator ruling); source contains book(77). Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <thumbdown()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Before <color(5)>Dewey<ce()> can beat us to it, we will enter the <book(75)>Zone<endbook()>, no matter what.
<topic()><operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>From here, I will go meet <color(4)>Sakuya<ce()>, and together we will bring about the Pororoca.
rows.notes: -sama honorific on Sakuya dropped per project convention (honorifics dropped elsewhere, e.g. 4003070/-san, 4003200/-kun); see uncertainties.

rows.en: <operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>Through the Pororoca, the barrier stretched over the <book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()><thumbnail(276)> will temporarily reverse, opening a path.

<operator(30130,1)><speed(2)>Beyond it, connected to the <book(76)>Promised Land<endbook()>, lies the <book(75)>Zone<endbook()>. The ones to open that path are <color(4)>Renton<ce()>, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>... you two.
rows.notes: Restructured so book(76) precedes book(75), matching source tag order.

rows.en: <thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Once <color(4)>Norb<ce()> and <color(4)>Sakuya<ce()> open the <book(75)>Zone<endbook()>, <color(4)>Renton<ce()> and <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> will lead us into the <book(75)>Zone<endbook()>, and every ship breaks through.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>This is a more dangerous operation than any we've faced, but we will absolutely make it succeed... and win our future!

uncertainties.issue: book(69) here wraps the full source word for 'Scub Coral', unlike scene 4003320 where book(69) wraps the shortened word for 'Scub' (per corpus precedent batch_05943.json); rendered accordingly per the actual source word each time.
Clause reordered ('driven by Getter Rays, become Invaders') to keep the four command tags (73,51,49,69) in the same order as the source; meaning unchanged.
'headed for' placed after the Great Wall tag, with thumbnail(285) sitting between 'beyond' and 'the Great Wall' as in the source; reads slightly compressed.

Source honorific '-sama' on Sakuya dropped to match project convention of dropping -san/-kun elsewhere (4003070, 4003200); no reviewed precedent found specifically for Sakuya, whom the Vodarac revere, so 'Lady Sakuya' would also be defensible. Flagging for orchestrator call.

Sentence restructured so 'the Promised Land' (book 76) precedes 'the Zone' (book 75), matching source order, at the cost of a slightly less direct English clause ('Beyond it, connected to the Promised Land, lies the Zone').

glossary_proposals.why: Norb and Sakuya's power to temporarily reverse the Great Wall's barrier so Renton and Eureka can pass through, named after the real Amazon tidal-bore phenomenon; not wrapped in a <book> tag in the source, so treated as a plain researched term rather than a locked book id. No prior project glossary entry found.
